payload.reason: The evidence suggests that pruning the complete graph to create an arborescence structure improves the training process by focusing on relevant relationships and reducing noise from irrelevant connections.

claims.text: Pruning the complete graph to an arborescence structure allows for a more focused training on relevant mention-entity relationships, improving model performance.
Using a complete graph may introduce noise and irrelevant connections that can hinder the learning process, while pruning helps to mitigate this issue.
The arborescence structure retains essential connections while simplifying the graph, which is beneficial for training the dual-encoder models effectively.
